ebus.name: External bus
ebus.purpose: Uncached instruction and data requests leaving Coral Core.

fabric.name: Core fabric

datapath.name: Internal datapath
datapath.purpose: Operand and result movement inside an execution engine.

instruction_flows.name: Scalar integer ALU
instruction_flows.summary: Fetch and decode a scalar integer instruction, execute it in an ALU lane, then write the result to the integer register file.

steps.title: Fetch instruction
steps.detail: Read a 128-bit instruction row from ITCM through the instruction path.

steps.title: Decode lane
steps.detail: Select one of the four decoded scalar lanes and identify its source and destination registers.

steps.title: Read operands
steps.detail: Check dependencies and read scalar operands from x0 through x31.

steps.title: Execute
steps.detail: Perform the integer arithmetic or logical operation in one of four ALU lanes.

steps.title: Write back
steps.detail: Commit the result to the integer register file and release the scoreboard dependency.

instruction_flows.name: Branch or jump
instruction_flows.summary: Resolve control flow in a branch lane and redirect the scalar fetch stage when the branch is taken.

steps.title: Fetch and decode
steps.detail: Fetch the instruction from ITCM and decode its branch operands and immediate.

steps.title: Read operands
steps.detail: Read the comparison operands from the integer register file.

steps.title: Resolve branch
steps.detail: Compare operands and calculate the target in one of four branch lanes.

steps.title: Redirect fetch
steps.detail: Update the scalar fetch path when the branch or jump changes control flow.

instruction_flows.name: Multiply or divide
instruction_flows.summary: Issue a decoded scalar operation to the dedicated multiply or divide unit and hold its destination dependency until completion.

steps.title: Fetch and decode
steps.detail: Fetch the instruction row and identify a multiply or divide operation.

steps.title: Reserve destination
steps.detail: The scoreboard records the pending destination before execution starts.

steps.title: Execute unit
steps.detail: Route operands to the dedicated multiply or divide datapath.

steps.title: Write back
steps.detail: Return the completed result and clear the destination dependency.

instruction_flows.name: Scalar load or store
instruction_flows.summary: Calculate a scalar memory address in the LSU and access a DTCM bank through the shared data-bus arbiter.

steps.title: Fetch and decode
steps.detail: Fetch the memory instruction and decode its base register

steps.title: Form address
steps.detail: Read the base or store data and calculate the effective address in the LSU.

steps.title: Arbitrate DBUS
steps.detail: Send the request through the compute enclosure to the DTCM arbiter.

steps.title: Access bank
steps.detail: Select one of four DTCM banks for the data transfer.

steps.title: Complete
steps.detail: A load writes its value to the integer register file; a store completes after memory accepts the data.

instruction_flows.name: Vector arithmetic
instruction_flows.summary: Decode a vector command in the scalar core, queue it, then execute across the vector ALU lanes.

steps.title: Decode vector command
steps.detail: The scalar front end recognizes and dispatches a vector operation.

steps.title: Queue command
steps.detail: Buffer the command until vector register dependencies are ready.

steps.title: Read vector operands
steps.detail: Read 8-bit

steps.title: Execute ALUs
steps.detail: Execute the operation in the paired vector ALU datapaths.

steps.title: Write vector result
steps.detail: Commit the result and release the vector scoreboard dependency.

instruction_flows.name: Vector MAC, multiply, or divide
instruction_flows.summary: Queue a vector command and execute it in the dedicated vector MAC, multiply, or divide datapath.

steps.title: Dispatch command
steps.detail: Decode the instruction in the scalar core and place it in the vector command queue.

steps.title: Wait for operands
steps.detail: Hold the command until the vector scoreboard reports its operands ready.

steps.title: Read vector registers
steps.detail: Supply vector operands from v0 through v31.

steps.title: Execute MAC unit
steps.detail: Perform multiply-accumulate

steps.title: Write vector result
steps.detail: Return the result to the vector register file and clear the dependency.

blocks.name: Coral System
blocks.summary: Planning boundary containing the Coral SoC and its external HyperRAM device.
responsibilities: Keep the chip boundary distinct from external memory.
Connect architectural claims to specifications and future RTL.

blocks.name: HyperRAM
blocks.summary: External memory device connected through the HyperRAM controller.
responsibilities: Provide capacity beyond the on-core software-managed memories.

blocks.name: Coral SoC
blocks.summary: Chip boundary joining compute, memory movement, interconnect, control, and peripherals.
responsibilities: Provide the shared AXI and TL-UL interconnect around Coral Core.
Coordinate reset, boot, memory movement, and peripheral access.

blocks.name: HyperRAM Controller
blocks.summary: Terminates the external HyperRAM interface and exposes memory over AXI.
responsibilities: Sequence HyperRAM initialization and memory transactions.
Accept AXI accesses from DMA and the SoC interconnect.

blocks.name: HyperRAM AXI Arbiter
blocks.summary: Arbitrates DMA and SoC-side requests targeting HyperRAM.
responsibilities: Select between AXI requesters targeting external memory.
Preserve response ownership and backpressure.

blocks.name: HyperRAM AXI–TL-UL Bridge
blocks.summary: Adapts HyperRAM-side AXI traffic to the SoC TL-UL fabric.
responsibilities: Translate request and response semantics across protocols.

blocks.name: DMA
blocks.summary: Moves data between memories under software control using one linked-list channel.
responsibilities: Fetch linked-list descriptors.
Generate source and destination addresses.
Move one read beat and one write beat per transfer in the current plan.

blocks.name: Coral Core
blocks.summary: Scalar/vector RISC-V compute block with software-managed ITCM and DTCM.
responsibilities: Execute scalar, RVV, and VME operations.
Route instruction, data, and external accesses to the correct memory path.
Expose AXI master and slave interfaces at the core boundary.

blocks.name: AXI Master · DRAM
blocks.summary: DMA AXI master path toward external memory.
responsibilities: Issue external-memory requests on behalf of an active transfer.

blocks.name: AXI Master · Core
blocks.summary: DMA AXI master path toward Coral Core TCMs.
responsibilities: Issue TCM accesses through Coral Core's AXI slave boundary.

blocks.name: Transfer FIFO
blocks.summary: Buffers transfer data between the DMA read and write sides.
responsibilities: Decouple read response timing from write request timing.

blocks.name: Control FSM
blocks.summary: Sequences descriptor fetch, transfer beats, completion, and error handling.
responsibilities: Coordinate the DMA transfer lifecycle.

blocks.name: Address Generator
blocks.summary: Produces source and destination addresses for each transfer beat.
responsibilities: Advance addresses according to descriptor parameters.

blocks.name: Configuration Registers
blocks.summary: Holds software-visible DMA configuration and status.
responsibilities: Present transfer control and status to software.

blocks.name: TL-UTL Port
blocks.summary: Connects DMA configuration and control to the SoC fabric.
responsibilities: Terminate TL-UL control transactions for the DMA.

blocks.name: Core AXI–TL-UL Bridge
blocks.summary: Adapts Coral Core external AXI requests to the TL-UL crossbar.
responsibilities: Convert the core's external requests into fabric transactions.

blocks.name: Core AXI Arbiter
blocks.summary: Arbitrates inbound AXI access to Coral Core between the DMA core master and the SoC fabric.
responsibilities: Select between DMA and fabric requests for the Coral Core AXI slave.
Present a single AXI master to the core boundary.

blocks.name: Core Slave AXI–TL-UL Bridge
blocks.summary: Adapts inbound TL-UL requests from the crossbar into AXI for the Coral Core arbiter.
responsibilities: Convert fabric transactions into AXI requests toward Coral Core.

blocks.name: TL-UL Crossbar
blocks.summary: Central SoC fabric connecting compute and memory paths to control and peripherals.
responsibilities: Decode TL-UL addresses and route requests to peripheral targets.
Preserve response routing and backpressure across hosts and devices.

blocks.name: Flash Controller
blocks.summary: Provides nonvolatile boot and program storage access.
responsibilities: Initialize flash and serve boot data to the system.

blocks.name: Host Link
blocks.summary: External host path used for host-assisted boot and control.
responsibilities: Load ITCM during host boot.
Provide a host-visible control and data path.

blocks.name: UART
blocks.summary: Serial communications peripheral on the TL-UL fabric.
responsibilities: Provide software-visible serial input and output.

blocks.name: Control
blocks.summary: SoC-level reset, boot, clock, interrupt, and control functions.
responsibilities: Coordinate reset release and boot-mode sequencing.
Surface interrupt and status signals.

blocks.name: Other Peripherals
blocks.summary: Planned TL-UL devices not yet decomposed in the architecture model.
responsibilities: Reserve an explicit expansion seam for future devices.

blocks.name: Other Devices
blocks.summary: Second unnamed device group on the crossbar, drawn below the fabric in the source diagram.
responsibilities: Reserve the second expansion seam the source diagram records.

blocks.name: AXI Slave
blocks.summary: Inbound AXI path used to access Coral Core memories and control state.
responsibilities: Accept host and DMA transactions at the core boundary.

blocks.name: AXI to Fabric
blocks.summary: Converts inbound AXI transactions into the internal fabric request form.
responsibilities: Adapt inbound AXI accesses for the internal memory fabric.

blocks.name: Fabric Mux
blocks.summary: Routes inbound fabric accesses toward the ITCM and DTCM arbitration paths.
responsibilities: Select the target memory path for inbound fabric requests.

blocks.name: Scalar + Vector Core
blocks.summary: Compute enclosure containing the scalar front end, vector execution engine, and 16×16 systolic-array accelerator.
responsibilities: Execute scalar instructions and dispatch vector or systolic-array commands.
Present instruction, data, and external request paths to the core fabric.

blocks.name: Scalar Core
blocks.summary: Four-lane scalar front end with integer execution, LSU, CSR, register file, and scoreboard.
responsibilities: Fetch and decode 128-bit instruction rows across four lanes.
Execute integer, branch, multiply, divide, load/store, and CSR operations.

blocks.name: Vector Execution Engine
blocks.summary: SIMD back end with queued commands, vector arithmetic, register file, and scoreboard.
responsibilities: Buffer vector instructions in the command queue.
Execute 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit vector operations.

blocks.name: 16×16 Systolic Array
blocks.summary: Solid black-box accelerator instance for a 16×16 processing-element array inside the compute cluster.
responsibilities: Accept array commands from the scalar front end.
Execute dense multiply-accumulate work across a 16×16 processing-element mesh.

blocks.name: Systolic Array
blocks.summary: Four-by-four processing-element mesh with activation, weight, and output buffering.
responsibilities: Stream activations horizontally through the processing-element rows.
Accumulate partial sums through the processing-element columns.

blocks.name: Arbiter
blocks.summary: Arbitrates outbound fetch and load/store traffic before the AXI master.
responsibilities: Select an outbound core request for the AXI master path.

blocks.name: AXI Master
blocks.summary: Outbound AXI interface for uncached Coral Core requests.
responsibilities: Issue uncached instruction and data transactions to the SoC.

blocks.name: Debug
blocks.summary: Debug request path into the tightly coupled memory arbiters.
responsibilities: Provide debug-originated access to the core memory paths.

blocks.name: IBUS Mux
blocks.summary: Selects the instruction-bus path toward the ITCM arbiter.
responsibilities: Route instruction fetch traffic into the ITCM arbitration path.

blocks.name: DTCM Arbiter
blocks.summary: Arbitrates scalar/vector data, inbound fabric, and debug accesses to DTCM.
responsibilities: Preserve single-port DTCM ownership across competing requesters.

blocks.name: DTCM · 4 Banks
blocks.summary: Four 128×512 banks providing 32 KiB of software-managed data memory.
responsibilities: Store scalar, vector, and matrix data in four visible memory banks.

blocks.name: ITCM Arbiter
blocks.summary: Arbitrates core fetch, inbound fabric, and debug accesses to ITCM.
responsibilities: Preserve single-port ITCM ownership across competing requesters.

blocks.name: ITCM · 1 Bank
blocks.summary: One 128×512 bank providing 8 KiB of software-managed instruction memory.
responsibilities: Store the 128-bit instruction rows consumed by the scalar fetch path.

blocks.name: 128×512 Bank 0
blocks.summary: First physical bank in the four-bank DTCM organization.
responsibilities: Store one quarter of the visible DTCM bank organization.

blocks.name: 128×512 Bank 1
blocks.summary: Second physical bank in the four-bank DTCM organization.
responsibilities: Store one quarter of the visible DTCM bank organization.

blocks.name: 128×512 Bank 2

responsibilities: Store one quarter of the visible DTCM bank organization.

blocks.name: 128×512 Bank 3
blocks.summary: Fourth physical bank in the four-bank DTCM organization.
responsibilities: Store one quarter of the visible DTCM bank organization.

blocks.name: 128×512 Bank
blocks.summary: Physical bank implementing the visible 8 KiB ITCM organization.
responsibilities: Store 128-bit instruction rows for the fetch path.

blocks.name: Fetch · 128-bit ×4
blocks.summary: Four-lane 128-bit instruction fetch stage shown in the scalar reference.
responsibilities: Fetch instruction rows for four scalar lanes.

blocks.name: Decode ×4
blocks.summary: Four-lane scalar instruction decode stage.
responsibilities: Decode scalar instructions for the execution units.

blocks.name: ALU ×4
blocks.summary: Four scalar arithmetic and logic lanes.
responsibilities: Execute scalar arithmetic and logic operations.

blocks.name: Branch Unit ×4
blocks.summary: Four scalar branch-processing lanes.
responsibilities: Resolve scalar branch operations.

blocks.name: Multiply
blocks.summary: Scalar multiplication execution unit.
responsibilities: Execute scalar multiplication operations.

blocks.name: Divide
blocks.summary: Scalar division execution unit.
responsibilities: Execute scalar division operations.

blocks.name: Load/Store Unit · LSU
blocks.summary: Scalar load/store execution and memory-request unit.
responsibilities: Issue scalar load and store operations.

blocks.name: Control/Status Registers · CSR
blocks.summary: Scalar control and status register bank.
responsibilities: Hold scalar architectural control and status state.

blocks.name: Integer Register File · 32-bit
blocks.summary: Thirty-two 32-bit integer registers with an attached scoreboard.
responsibilities: Store x0 through x31 and track register dependencies.

blocks.name: x0 · x1 · … · x31
blocks.summary: The visible set of thirty-two scalar integer registers.
responsibilities: Store the scalar integer architectural state.

blocks.name: Scoreboard
blocks.summary: Tracks scalar register dependencies.
responsibilities: Track dependencies involving the integer register file.

blocks.name: Vector Command Queue
blocks.summary: FIFO-backed queue decoupling scalar dispatch from vector execution.
responsibilities: Buffer vector instructions until their dependencies resolve.

blocks.name: Vector ALU ×2
blocks.summary: Two vector arithmetic and logic lanes.
responsibilities: Execute vector arithmetic and logic operations.

blocks.name: Vector MAC/MUL/DIV
blocks.summary: Vector multiply-accumulate, multiply, and divide execution unit.
responsibilities: Execute vector MAC
multiply
and divide operations.

blocks.name: Vector Register File · 128-bit
blocks.summary: Thirty-two 128-bit vector registers with an attached scoreboard.
responsibilities: Store v0 through v31 and track vector dependencies.

blocks.name: v0 · v1 · … · v31
blocks.summary: The visible set of thirty-two vector registers.
responsibilities: Store the vector architectural state.

blocks.name: Scoreboard
blocks.summary: Tracks dependencies involving the vector register file.
responsibilities: Track vector register dependencies before command issue.

blocks.name: 4×4 PE + Weight Buffer Grid

responsibilities: Propagate activations from left to right across four rows.
Propagate and accumulate partial sums through four columns.

blocks.name: Processing Element Detail
blocks.summary: Reference processing element showing activation and partial-sum paths.
responsibilities: Expose the multiply
add
activation-register
and output-register data paths.

blocks.name: Input Activation
blocks.summary: Activation input entering the processing element from the left.
responsibilities: Provide activation data to multiplication and activation forwarding.

blocks.name: Weight
blocks.summary: Weight input entering the processing element from above.
responsibilities: Provide the local multiply operand.

blocks.name: Input Partial Sum
blocks.summary: Partial-sum input entering the processing element from above.
responsibilities: Provide the accumulation operand to the adder.

blocks.name: Multiply
blocks.summary: Multiplies the input activation by the local weight.
responsibilities: Produce the activation-by-weight product.

blocks.name: Add
blocks.summary: Adds the product to the incoming partial sum.
responsibilities: Produce the next accumulated partial sum.

blocks.name: Activation Register
blocks.summary: Registers the activation before forwarding it to the right.
responsibilities: Pipeline activation data across the array row.

blocks.name: Output Activation
blocks.summary: Registered activation output leaving the processing element to the right.
responsibilities: Forward activation data to the next processing element.

blocks.name: Output Register
blocks.summary: Registers the accumulated partial sum before it leaves the processing element.
responsibilities: Pipeline the accumulated partial sum.

blocks.name: Output Partial Sum
blocks.summary: Registered partial-sum output leaving the processing element downward.
responsibilities: Forward the partial sum to the next row or output buffer.
